components.name: Primary X-Ray Button
components.description: Starts the local demo cutaway and carries the only filled action treatment.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:flex; min-height:50px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:12px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid #d9492f; border-radius:2px; color:#fffaf2; background:#d9492f; font:750 0.76rem/1 Archivo Variable,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.075em; transition:color 160ms ease-out,background-color 160ms ease-out,transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#a92e1b; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2d6571; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: URL Field
components.description: Square-cornered public URL entry field with an inspection focus state.
components.css: .ds-url-field { display:grid; gap:9px; color:#565b51; font:700 0.68rem/1.35 Courier New,monospace; letter-spacing:0.14em; } .ds-url-field input { width:100%; min-height:55px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid #20251f; border-radius:0; outline:0; color:#20251f; background:rgba(243,237,227,.46); font:400 0.96rem/1.4 Archivo Variable,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:normal; } .ds-url-field input:focus-visible { border-color:#2d6571; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #2d6571; outline:3px solid #2d6571; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Evidence Action
components.description: Opens the provenance path for the hero finding or selected object.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:flex; min-height:42px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:12px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid #20251f; border-radius:2px; color:#20251f; background:transparent; font:750 0.76rem/1 Archivo Variable,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.075em; transition:color 160ms ease-out,background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color:#f3ede3; background:#20251f; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2d6571; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Instrument Rail
components.description: Continuous bottom control rail for inspection modes, replay, and reveal timeline.
components.css: .ds-rail { display:flex; min-height:78px; align-items:stretch; border-top:1px solid rgba(32,37,31,.31); background:#f3ede3; } .ds-rail button { position:relative; min-width:90px; padding:0 18px; border:0; border-right:1px solid rgba(32,37,31,.31); color:#20251f; background:transparent; font:750 0.67rem/1 Archivo Variable,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.1em; } .ds-rail button:hover { background:rgba(184,170,139,.28); } .ds-rail button.is-active { color:#a92e1b; } .ds-rail button.is-active::after { position:absolute; right:18px; bottom:0; left:18px; height:3px; background:#d9492f; content:""; } .ds-rail button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2d6571; outline-offset:-3px; }

components.name: Owner Delete Action
components.description: Subordinate destructive action shown only when the active published result has a valid browser-held deletion key.
components.css: .ds-owner-delete { display:flex; min-height:38px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:9px; padding:0 12px; border:0; border-top:1px solid rgba(169,46,27,.38); color:#a92e1b; background:transparent; font:750 .68rem/1 Archivo Variable,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.09em; transition:color 160ms ease-out,background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-owner-delete:hover { color:#fffaf2; background:#a92e1b; } .ds-owner-delete:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2d6571; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Scan Job Readout
components.description: Inline live status for admission, capture, mapping, publication, and terminal recovery without hiding the current result.
components.css: .ds-job-readout { display:grid; min-width:0; grid-template-columns:10px minmax(0,1fr); align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:9px 0; border-top:1px solid rgba(32,37,31,.31); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(32,37,31,.31); color:#2d6571; font-family:Courier New,monospace; } .ds-job-readout > span:last-child { display:grid; min-width:0; gap:2px; } .ds-job-readout strong { font-size:.64rem; letter-spacing:.11em; } .ds-job-readout small { overflow:hidden; color:#565b51; font-size:.58rem; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-job-mark { width:9px; height:9px; border:1px solid currentColor; background:currentColor; animation:ds-job-pulse 900ms ease-in-out infinite alternate; } .ds-job-readout.is-ready .ds-job-mark { animation:none; } .ds-job-readout.is-error { color:#a92e1b; } @keyframes ds-job-pulse { to { opacity:.25; } }

narrative.overview:
DOM X-Ray is a public visual instrument: a captured page is laid out like a physical architectural model, then separated into structure, weight, and external-origin relationships. The visual world is warm paper and graphite with a small amount of inspection red for the consequential finding and external teal for machinery outside the page boundary. It is editorial and tactile, but remains precise enough to expose the evidence behind every emphasized object.

The first viewport uses a quiet instrument column beside a dominant 3D cutaway. The left column carries identity, URL input, capture status, and one hero fact; the model owns the right side; a continuous rail anchors modes and playback at the bottom. The build is intentionally flat and material-led: no gradients, glassmorphism, neon cyberpunk, dashboard card grid, or decorative 3D particles.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper, board, drafting-film, graphite-line, and brass-registration materials.
One red finding language; teal is reserved for external-origin topology and focus.
A 3D architectural cutaway paired with a complete text/object-index fallback.
Evidence is a first-class path, not decorative annotation.
Deliberate reveal, bounded orbit, and reduced-motion stage stepping.
A compact worker-status readout that keeps scan progress and recovery in the instrument column.

rules.name: The Sparse Accent Rule
rules.body: Red and teal are measurement signals. Keep them rare and purposeful; do not turn the whole surface into an accent field.

rules.name: The One Finding Rule
rules.body: The title is the strongest typographic object; the dynamic hero statement is second. Supporting metrics must not compete with the causal statement.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest on the paper field. Physical depth belongs to the cutaway model and evidence drawer, not to a dashboard-like stack of cards.

dos: Do preserve the warm paper / graphite field and use red only for inspection findings, selection, and active state.
Do keep the 28/72 split and the model as the dominant visual subject on desktop.
Do make every emphasized object traceable to raw evidence and its mapping rule.
Do retain the hero statement and evidence in reduced-motion, text-only, and no-WebGL paths.
Do use thin rules, board/drafting-film layering, brass registration, and compact mono readouts to create depth.
Do keep scan admission/progress, terminal status, and recovery visible inline without displacing a valid current result.
donts: Don't turn the viewer into a scorecard, bento dashboard, generic monitoring workspace, or roast interface.
Don't use gradients, glassmorphism, neon cyberpunk, ambient particles, liquid blobs, perpetual bobbing, or decorative wire motion.
Don't make third-party origin teal imply “tracker”; preserve the external-origin meaning.
Don't replace the continuous bottom rail with a row of floating cards.
Don't let a spectacular 3D object outrun its evidence, or let essential facts depend on WebGL.
Don't show share/copy affordances for unpublished fixture-only previews.
